Start date: 1304-02-25  
Subtract 30 weeks = 210 days.  
Subtract 2 more days = total 212 days earlier.  

1304 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
Feb 25 minus 212 days:  
Go back to Jan 1: 25 days in Feb (leap) → Jan 31 is 25 days earlier (Feb 25 → Jan 31). Remaining: 212 - 25 = 187 days earlier from Jan 31.  
Jan 31 back 31 days → Dec 31, 1303. Remaining: 187 - 31 = 156 days earlier from Dec 31, 1303.  
Count back through 1303 (not leap):  
Dec: 31 days, Nov: 30, Oct: 31, Sep: 30, Aug: 31, Jul: 31, Jun: 30, May: 31, Apr: 30, Mar: 31, Feb: 28, Jan: 31.  
From Dec 31:  
Back 31 (Dec) → Nov 30, left 125.  
Back 30 (Nov) → Oct 31, left 95.  
Back 31 (Oct) → Sep 30, left 64.  
Back 30 (Sep) → Aug 31, left 34.  
Back 31 (Aug) → Jul 31, left 3.  
Back 3 more days from Jul 31 → Jul 28, 1303.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1303-07-28
